entries.physical_mechanism: Thermonuclear runaway of a carbon-oxygen white dwarf approaching Chandrasekhar mass
entries.diagnostic_signatures: Si II 6355A absorption, rapid post-peak decline, lack of hydrogen lines

entries.physical_mechanism: Gravitational collapse of an iron core in a massive star (>8 solar masses)
entries.diagnostic_signatures: Prominent Balmer hydrogen P-Cygni lines, extended 80-100 day optical plateau (Type II-P)

entries.physical_mechanism: Magnetic reconnection releasing stored magnetic energy in stellar corona
entries.diagnostic_signatures: Rapid rise in minutes (FRED profile), quick fading in hours, associated with quiescent red point source
entries.literature_reference: Kowalski et al. (2013), Schmidt et al. (2019)

entries.physical_mechanism: Stellar pulsations driven by kappa-mechanism in helium ionization zone
entries.diagnostic_signatures: Strictly periodic variation in Lomb-Scargle periodogram, asymmetric saw-tooth or sinusoidal light curve

entries.physical_mechanism: Stellar merger in binary system accompanied by common-envelope dynamic ejection
entries.diagnostic_signatures: Double-peaked light curve, rapid color reddening, intense late-time NIR dust emission
entries.literature_reference: Ivanova et al. (2013), Pastorello et al. (2019)

entries.physical_mechanism: Central millisecond magnetar spin-down or circumstellar interaction
entries.diagnostic_signatures: Extreme peak luminosity, broad early O II absorption, prolonged blue UV emission

entries.physical_mechanism: Hydrodynamic disruption of a star passing within tidal radius of a supermassive black hole
entries.diagnostic_signatures: Centroid coincident with galactic nucleus (offset < 0.1 arcsec), smooth t^{-5/3} decline, non-evolving blue temperature
